research_question: Machine learning models using routine clinical/demographic tabular variables to predict stroke risk: what performance (Recall, PR-AUC, ROC-AUC) do they report, and how do the data split protocol and class-imbalance handling (SMOTE, class weighting) affect the reported results?

inclusion: Du doan nguy co dot quy (incident stroke) bang ML tren du lieu dang bang: nhan khau hoc, lam sang, xet nghiem, EHR
Bao cao it nhat mot chi so dinh luong: Recall/Sensitivity, AUC, F1
Bai bao binh duyet tren tap chi SJR Q1/Q2 hoac hoi nghi top co double-blind review, xuat ban 2020-2026
Uu tien: dung bo Kaggle Stroke Prediction Dataset (5,110 mau) hoac co mo ta ro giao thuc chia du lieu va xu ly mat can bang
exclusion: Chi dung anh y te (CT/MRI) hoac tin hieu (ECG/EEG) lam dau vao chinh
Du doan ket cuc sau dot quy (tu vong, phuc hoi chuc nang, tai phat) thay vi nguy co mac moi
Preprint chua binh duyet, conference abstract, editorial, letter
Review/meta-analysis: khong dua vao ma tran chinh, chi dung lam boi canh (vd. Soladoye 2025)
